passages.text: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary, as well as the holy garments for Aaron, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The people used blue yarn, purple yarn, and scarlet yarn.
They made special garments from these materials.
These garments were for serving in the holy place.
They also made holy garments for Aaron.
Aaron was the high priest.
They made everything as the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַתְּכֵ֤לֶת וְהָֽאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת הַשָּׁנִ֔י עָשׂ֥וּ בִגְדֵי־ שְׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

passages.text: Bezalel made the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel was a skilled craftsman.
He made the ephod.
He used finely spun linen.
He embroidered the ephod with gold.
He also used blue yarn.
He used purple yarn.
He used scarlet yarn.
passages.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

passages.text: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut threads from them to interweave with the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen—the work of a skilled craftsman.
passages.sermon:
Skilled craftsmen worked on the ephod for the sanctuary.
They took gold and hammered it into thin sheets.
They cut the gold sheets into threads.
They wove the gold threads into blue yarn.
They wove the gold threads into purple yarn.
They wove the gold threads into scarlet yarn.
They wove the gold threads into fine linen.
They made all of this with great skill.
passages.original: וַֽיְרַקְּע֞וּ אֶת־ פַּחֵ֣י הַזָּהָב֮ וְקִצֵּ֣ץ פְּתִילִם֒ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת בְּת֤וֹךְ הַתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וּבְת֣וֹךְ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּבְת֛וֹךְ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וּבְת֣וֹךְ הַשֵּׁ֑שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃

passages.text: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached at two of its corners, so it could be fastened.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel made the ephod for the high priest.
He made shoulder pieces for the ephod.
He attached the shoulder pieces at two corners of the ephod.
This allowed the ephod to be fastened.
passages.original: כְּתֵפֹ֥ת עָֽשׂוּ־ ל֖וֹ חֹבְרֹ֑ת עַל־ שְׁנֵ֥י קִצְווֹתוֹ חֻבָּֽר׃

passages.text: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod was of one piece with the ephod, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The ephod was a special garment for the high priest.
The ephod had a waistband.
The waistband was skillfully woven.
The waistband was made as one piece with the ephod.
The waistband had the same workmanship as the ephod.
They used gold to make the waistband.
They used blue yarn to make the waistband.
They used purple yarn to make the waistband.
They used scarlet yarn to make the waistband.
They used finely spun linen to make the waistband.
The craftsmen made the waistband just as the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: וְחֵ֨שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּת֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֗יו מִמֶּ֣נּוּ הוּא֮ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ֒ זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The craftsmen made onyx stones.
They set the onyx stones in gold filigree settings.
They engraved the onyx stones like a seal.
They engraved the names of the sons of Israel on the stones.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם מֻֽסַבֹּ֖ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב מְפֻתָּחֹת֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם עַל־ שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The craftsmen made the ephod for the high priest.
They took the onyx stones.
They fastened the stones onto the shoulder pieces of the ephod.
These stones served as memorial stones.
The stones reminded people of the sons of Israel.
The craftsmen did everything as the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֗ם עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּר֖וֹן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

passages.text: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship as the ephod, with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
passages.sermon:
A craftsman made the breastpiece.
He used the same skilled work as for the ephod.
He used gold.
He used blue yarn.
He used purple yarn.
He used scarlet yarn.
He used finely spun linen.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת־ הַחֹ֛שֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

passages.text: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
passages.sermon:
The breastpiece was square.
They folded the breastpiece over to make it double.
It measured a span in length.
It measured a span in width.
It was double thickness.
passages.original: רָב֧וּעַ הָיָ֛ה כָּפ֖וּל עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת־ הַחֹ֑שֶׁן זֶ֧רֶת אָרְכּ֛וֹ וְזֶ֥רֶת רָחְבּ֖וֹ כָּפֽוּל׃

passages.text: And they mounted on it four rows of gemstones: The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald; the second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond; the third row had a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst; and the fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.
passages.sermon:
They made the breastpiece for the high priest.
They placed four rows of gemstones on the breastpiece.
The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald.
The second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond.
The third row had a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.
The fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper.
They set each stone in a gold filigree setting.
passages.original: וַיְמַלְאוּ־ ב֔וֹ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה ט֣וּרֵי אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד׃ וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃ וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃ וְהַטּוּר֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מֽוּסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The twelve stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel. Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
passages.sermon:
The breastpiece had twelve stones.
Each stone matched one of the sons of Israel.
There were twelve sons of Israel.
Each stone had a name engraved on it.
The engravings were like seals.
Each name was the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
passages.original: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִים עַל־ שְׁמֹ֨ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הֵ֛נָּה שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־ שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־ שְׁמ֔וֹ לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט׃

passages.text: For the breastpiece they made braided chains like cords of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
The craftsmen made chains for the breastpiece.
They braided the chains.
The chains looked like cords.
They used pure gold to make the chains.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ עַל־ הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃

passages.text: They also made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the two rings to the two corners of the breastpiece.
passages.sermon:
The craftsmen made the breastpiece for the high priest.
They made two gold filigree settings.
They made two gold rings.
They fastened the two gold rings to the two corners of the breastpiece.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וּשְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

passages.text: Then they fastened the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece, and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites made the breastpiece for the high priest.
They made two gold chains.
They made two gold rings.
They attached the two gold chains to the two gold rings.
The gold rings were at the corners of the breastpiece.
They took the other ends of the two gold chains.
They attached these ends to two gold filigree settings.
They put the filigree settings on the shoulder pieces of the ephod.
They placed them at the front of the ephod.
passages.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ הָעֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת עַל־ קְצ֖וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃ וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָֽעֲבֹתֹ֔ת נָתְנ֖וּ עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹ֑ת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֛ם עַל־ כִּתְפֹ֥ת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל־ מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו׃

passages.text: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
passages.sermon:
Skilled craftsmen made the breastpiece for the high priest.
They made two more gold rings.
They attached these rings to the other two corners of the breastpiece.
They placed the rings on the inside edge of the breastpiece.
This edge was next to the ephod.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וַיָּשִׂ֕ימוּ עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל־ שְׂפָת֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל־ עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה׃

passages.text: They made two additional gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near the seam just above its woven waistband.
passages.sermon:
The craftsmen made the ephod for the high priest.
They made two gold rings.
They attached the two gold rings to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod.
They placed the rings on the front of the ephod.
They put the rings near the seam of the ephod.
The seam was just above the woven waistband of the ephod.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָב֒ וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֡ם עַל־ שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֤ד מִלְמַ֙טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתּ֑וֹ מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃

passages.text: Then they tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites made the breastpiece for the high priest.
They attached rings to the breastpiece.
They also attached rings to the ephod.
They used a blue cord to tie the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod.
This kept the breastpiece above the waistband of the ephod.
The breastpiece did not swing out from the ephod.
They did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: וַיִּרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־ הַחֹ֡שֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָיו֩ אֶל־ טַבְּעֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֜ד בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֗לֶת לִֽהְיֹת֙ עַל־ חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְלֹֽא־ יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver, with an opening in the center of the robe like that of a garment, with a collar around the opening so that it would not tear.
passages.sermon:
The craftsmen made the robe for the ephod.
They used blue cloth for the robe.
A skilled weaver made the robe.
The robe had an opening in its center.
The opening was like the opening of a garment.
They made a collar around the opening.
The collar went all around the opening.
The collar kept the robe from tearing.
passages.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־ מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפֹ֖ד מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג כְּלִ֖יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃ וּפִֽי־ הַמְּעִ֥יל בְּתוֹכ֖וֹ כְּפִ֣י תַחְרָ֑א שָׂפָ֥ה לְפִ֛יו סָבִ֖יב לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites made the robe for the high priest Aaron.
They made pomegranates for the lower hem of the robe.
They used blue yarn.
They used purple yarn.
They used scarlet yarn.
They used finely spun linen.
They placed the pomegranates on the lower hem of the robe.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עַל־ שׁוּלֵ֣י הַמְּעִ֔יל רִמּוֹנֵ֕י תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֑י מָשְׁזָֽר׃

passages.text: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates, alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
Skilled craftsmen made bells.
They used pure gold to make the bells.
They attached the bells to the hem of the robe.
They placed the bells between the pomegranates on the hem.
They arranged the bells and pomegranates in an alternating pattern around the lower hem of the robe.
The robe was for Aaron the high priest to wear while serving in the tabernacle.
They did this work just as the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ פַעֲמֹנֵ֖י זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת־ הַפַּֽעֲמֹנִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִ֗ים עַל־ שׁוּלֵ֤י הַמְּעִיל֙ סָבִ֔יב בְּת֖וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃ פַּעֲמֹ֤ן וְרִמֹּן֙ פַּעֲמֹ֣ן וְרִמֹּ֔ן עַל־ שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִ֑יב לְשָׁרֵ֕ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver, as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen, and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites made special garments for Aaron and his sons.
They made tunics from fine linen.
A skilled weaver made these tunics.
They made a turban from fine linen.
They made ornate headbands from fine linen.
They made undergarments from finely spun linen.
They made a sash from finely spun linen.
They embroidered the sash with blue yarn.
They embroidered the sash with purple yarn.
They embroidered the sash with scarlet yarn.
A skilled embroiderer made the sash.
They did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־ הַכָּתְנֹ֥ת שֵׁ֖שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃ וְאֵת֙ הַמִּצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְאֶת־ פַּאֲרֵ֥י הַמִּגְבָּעֹ֖ת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאֶת־ מִכְנְסֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃ וְֽאֶת־ הָאַבְנֵ֞ט שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and they engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites made a plate for the holy crown.
They used pure gold to make the plate.
They engraved words on the plate.
The engraving was like an inscription on a seal.
The words said: HOLY TO THE LORD.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־ צִ֥יץ נֵֽזֶר־ הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּכְתְּב֣וּ עָלָ֗יו מִכְתַּב֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites made a plate of pure gold for the holy crown.
They engraved on it: "Holy to the LORD."
They attached a blue cord to the plate.
They used the blue cord to fasten the plate to the turban.
They placed the plate above the turban.
They did this exactly as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.original: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָיו֙ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לָתֵ֥ת עַל־ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites built the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was also called the Tent of Meeting.
They finished all the work for it.
The LORD had given commands to Moses.
The Israelites did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֕כֶל כָּל־ עֲבֹדַ֕ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃פ

passages.text: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent with all its furnishings, its clasps, its frames, its crossbars, and its posts and bases; the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather, and the veil of the covering; the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the mercy seat; the table with all its utensils and the Bread of the Presence; the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its utensils, as well as the oil for the light; the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent; the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand; the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases; the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and tent pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting; and the woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites finished building the tabernacle.
They brought the tabernacle to Moses.
They brought the tent and all its furnishings.
They brought the clasps, the frames, the crossbars, the posts, and the bases.
They brought the covering made from ram skins dyed red.
They brought the covering made from fine leather.
They brought the veil that covered the entrance.
They brought the ark of the Testimony.
They brought the poles for carrying the ark.
They brought the mercy seat for the ark.
They brought the table and all its utensils.
They brought the Bread of the Presence for the table.
They brought the pure gold lampstand.
They brought the row of lamps for the lampstand.
They brought all the utensils for the lampstand.
They brought the oil for the light.
They brought the gold altar.
They brought the anointing oil.
They brought the fragrant incense.
They brought the curtain for the entrance to the tent.
They brought the bronze altar.
They brought the bronze grating for the altar.
They brought the poles for the bronze altar.
They brought all the utensils for the bronze altar.
They brought the basin and its stand.
They brought the curtains for the courtyard.
They brought the posts and bases for the courtyard.
They brought the curtain for the gate of the courtyard.
They brought the ropes and the tent pegs.
They brought all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.
They brought the woven garments for serving in the sanctuary.
They brought the holy garments for Aaron the priest.
They brought the garments for Aaron’s sons to serve as priests.
passages.original: וַיָּבִ֤יאוּ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ הָאֹ֖הֶל וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו קְרָסָ֣יו קְרָשָׁ֔יו בְּרִיחוֹ וְעַמֻּדָ֥יו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃ וְאֶת־ מִכְסֵ֞ה עוֹרֹ֤ת הָֽאֵילִם֙ הַמְאָדָּמִ֔ים וְאֶת־ מִכְסֵ֖ה עֹרֹ֣ת הַתְּחָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃ אֶת־ אֲרֹ֥ן הָעֵדֻ֖ת וְאֶת־ בַּדָּ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃ אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃ אֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָ֨ה הַטְּהֹרָ֜ה אֶת־ נֵרֹתֶ֗יהָ נֵרֹ֛ת הַמַּֽעֲרָכָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר׃ וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃ אֵ֣ת׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת וְאֶת־ מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ אֶת־ בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־ כַּנּֽוֹ׃ אֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֶת־ עַמֻּדֶ֣יהָ וְאֶת־ אֲדָנֶ֗יהָ וְאֶת־ הַמָּסָךְ֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֶת־ מֵיתָרָ֖יו וִיתֵדֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֗ת כָּל־ כְּלֵ֛י עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃

passages.text: The Israelites had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were the people God chose.
God gave Moses commands for the work.
The Israelites did all the work.
They did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֤ן עָשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כָּל־ הָעֲבֹדָֽה׃

passages.text: And Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had accomplished it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses looked at all the work the Israelites had done.
He saw everything they made.
They did the work exactly as the LORD commanded.
Moses saw they obeyed the LORD.
Moses blessed the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨רְא מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֗ה וְהִנֵּה֙ עָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה כֵּ֣ן עָשׂ֑וּ וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֹתָ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
